    ====Usage notes==== *The plural form "heavens" or "the heavens" has been typical in reference to the impersonal sky since the 17th century. The plural form became less common in reference to the abode of God, the gods, or the blessed departed as the medieval view of [[celestial sphere]]s was disproven; it is still commonly used, however, in discussing theologies such as [[Buddhism]] which retain numerous heavens or levels of heaven. * The term is capitalized as '''[[Heavens]]''' or "the Heavens" when (infrequently) used as a proper name. ====Derived terms====
